model.name: Prinz et al. 2003/2004 stomatogastric LP neuron (LP_2 parameter set)
model.citation: Prinz AA, Billimoria CP, Marder E (2003). Alternative to Hand-Tuning Conductance-Based Models: Construction and Analysis of Databases of Model Neurons. Journal of Neurophysiology 90(6):3998-4015. doi:10.1152/jn.00641.2003 | Prinz AA, Bucher D, Marder E (2004). Similar network activity from disparate circuit parameters. Nature Neuroscience 7(12):1345-1352. doi:10.1038/nn1352
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment; STG channel set without CaT, H 0.05 mS/cm2. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): shipped harness LP[0] (0 nS synapse, no pulse) fires 25 spikes in 5 s, median ISI 210 ms; spontaneously active. -0.3 nA for 1 s (no spike before or during the step): sag ratio 0.24, recovery 6.5 mV, 16 rebound spikes. Ih-block control (H density 0, same current): sag and recovery fall to about 0, end-of-step potential 9.8 mV lower, 10 rebound spikes, so the screened sag depends on Ih. At -0.1 and -0.2 nA the cell spikes during the step, so sag is undefined there.
model.inclusion_reason: Candidate only together with prinz2004_abpd (same paper, channel files and harness; never split across discovery/held-out). Clearest Ih-dependent sag in the screen, but from one protocol in a spontaneously active cell. Its recorded cell receives no stimulus in the shipped harness, so the canonical test is spontaneous activity.
